english.title: Keeper of horse fail to return passport to passport issuing organisation within 30 days of the death of the horse
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of a horse, namely **(..SPECIFY HORSE..), which died in circumstances other than those outlined in regulation 13(1) or 13(2) of the Horse Passports Regulations 2009, failed to return its passport to the passport issuing organisation within 30 days of that horse's death
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 13(3) and 22 of the Horse Passports Regulations 2009.
